subject: Renewal proposal: Premium SLA + capacity uplift for Globex Corp
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@globex.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Tom Chen <tom.chen@globex.com>
Cc: legal@globex.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal conversation: SLA upgrade + capacity increase

Hi Rishi,

Hope you’re well — our renewal for the Redwood contract comes up in ~45 days (May 31). Over the past year our usage has exceeded our committed capacity on most weekdays and the latency tail has started to impact product QoE for a key customer segment.

We’re exploring a renewal that includes:
- Premium SLA (24/7 support, 15-minute incident response, monthly latency SLOs)
- Latency SLO targets for p50/p95 for real-time features
- Capacity uplift: move from 30 reserved GPU-hours/day to 60 (2x) with an option to burst another 20% during launch windows

Could you share a proposed amendment and a commercial quote (including any uplift pricing and term length options)? We’ll need the proposal to feed our procurement & legal review.

Appreciate if we can get an initial proposal by next week so we can schedule an exec review the week after.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Platform Engineering
Globex Corp

Attachment: N/A
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Cc: legal@globex.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation: SLA upgrade + capacity increase

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear summary and flag. Great to hear the product is scaling (and sorry to hear about the tail latency). I’ve attached a draft amendment (redwood_sla_proposal_v2.pdf) and a high-level commercial quote (quote_GLX-2027.pdf) that shows pricing for 12- and 24-month terms and the capacity uplift you requested.

Key points in the draft:
- Premium Support (Gold): 24/7 support, 15-minute P1 response, dedicated escalation path to our SRE on-call.
- Latency SLOs: p50 target 60ms, p95 target 220ms (measured at the route level; retention and measurement details in the appendix).
- Capacity: 2x reserved pool (60 GPU-hours/day) with a burst pool equal to 20% of reserved capacity for launch windows (pre-negotiated).
- Ramp: We can phase the burst entitlement over the first 30 days with a canary rollout for the new model configs to validate tail behavior.

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick alignment call (30m) with you + procurement + our sales + SRE to walk the amendment and operational runbook
2) If acceptable, issue a DocuSign for signature and then schedule a post-signature 2-week ramp plan with CS.

Are you available Thu 22 Apr between 10–11am PT or Mon 26 Apr 2–3pm PT?

I’ll also loop in our internal finance and legal for any commercial concessions.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal conversation: SLA upgrade + capacity increase — need commercial sign-off

Folks — forwarding Globex’s ask. Summary: they want Premium SLA (Gold) + 2x reserved capacity + 20% burst. They need an initial proposal for procurement/legal next week.

Quote options attached: 12-month vs 24-month. I recommend the following concession structure if we need to move fast:
- 12-month term: standard list pricing + 10% introductory discount on base recurring for the first year
- 24-month term: 15% discount + 6-month price lock; add 30-day SLA performance credit schedule (credit tiers by p95 breaches)

Operational asks: we should offer a 30-day canary for the latency SLA where we run the upgraded configs with a monitoring window; during the canary we don’t apply SLA credits but we commit to a remediation plan if p95 exceeds target three times in that window.

Can finance/price and legal review the quote_GLX-2027.pdf and the proposed concession? Also confirm if we can pre-approve a one-time infrastructure migration credit (up to $8k) to help them with model tuning and KV cache priming.

Thanks — Rishi

Marta — thanks again for the calendar time last week. Following internal alignment, here’s what we can commit to for the renewal: 

1) Commercials
- 24-month term selected by Globex: 15% discount on base recurring, 6-month price lock, deal id GLX-2027-REN-004.
- One-time $8,000 migration & tuning credit applied to first invoice.

2) SLA & Support
- Premium (Gold) Support: 24/7 coverage, 15-minute P1 response, named SRE escalation path.
- Latency SLOs: p50 target 60ms, p95 target 220ms (route-level, 1-minute aggregation windows).
- Canary: 30-day canary where we phase up capacity (25% -> 60% -> full) over two weeks. During canary we will monitor metrics and agree on go/no-go criteria; SLA credits not applied during canary but we commit to a remediation plan if p95 exceeds target more than 3 times.

3) Capacity
- Reserved capacity: 60 GPU-hours/day.
- Burst pool: 20% of reserved capacity for predefined launch windows; usage over burst will be billed at overage rates per the attached quote.

Next steps:
- I’ve attached the redlined amendment and the final quote (quote_GLX-2027.pdf). If this looks good, I’ll send a DocuSign for signature and propose a technical kickoff for the week following signature (CS, SRE, and your platform team).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2B3C-sla-proposal
